annotations.title: Speak a line in a saved voice

description: Speaks a line or a saved script in a saved voice and returns a job whose result links the audio. Spends a few of the account's credits. Without a quote the call returns the cost and makes nothing; pass the quote with the same request after the person confirms it; a voice that cannot be priced ahead cannot be made here. A cloned voice needs its owner's recorded consent.

quote.description: A quote for exactly this line, when you hold one.

script.description: Or the id of a saved script to speak.
